story_review.one_viewing_summary: From the silent phone strips and the current board. A lattice tower's camera sweeps the plains. 16 of 56 slots light. At the tower's foot the beam finds smoke, but the smoke and the flag box sit on an oil pumpjack. An alert card runs down the tower and lands on a gloved phone. A watch marks an estimated window of up to ten minutes. The plume keeps burning and the cameras don't prevent fires. In a cut-in a dashed line rises from an alert card that sits on the caption band toward a station badge and stops short. The utility's wildfire lead reports no major fire since launch over a calendar with no red mark. The response record stays blank. The plan waits on state approval.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on the camera watching all the way around and ends on the alert landed, the line to responders open and the plan awaiting approval, but the hero image implies a pumpjack fire.
story_review.weakest_transition: s5-shot-2 to s6-shot-1: from the cut-in on the truck and station to a medium of the shelter wall.
